scenes.say: Grocery store, café or online? One label decides.

scenes.title: The grocery store.
scenes.say: Easy to find. Often just a best-before date.

scenes.title: Your local café.
scenes.say: Taste it first. Ask the staff. Check the date.

scenes.title: Online roasters.
scenes.say: The widest choice. But you wait for shipping.
Whole beans count as fresh about three weeks. Find the roast date.
Check the roast date every time. Save this for your next bag.
